Jordan - PM: Quick async check-in for Q2 OKR milestone status (owners/deps). Post 1-2 line updates: shipped / slipped / blockers / next step. TL;DR at bottom.
Alex M: Shipped -> routing v2 canary (PR #5423) :shipit: Throughput +18% on canary, no customer-facing changes yet. Owner: Alex M.
Maria P: Shipped -> embed-cache rewrite (release v1.3.0). Dashboard added. Seeing intermittent p95 memory spike on long prompts, investigating.
Sam L: Slipped -> Dedicated KMS integration moved to next sprint. Blocker: external KMS vendor audit + infra quota hold. Owner: Sam L. Need compliance + infra help.
Devon (eng-runtime): CR ping @Sam L @Alex M for PR #5480 (kv-cache locking fix). Quick review would help, aim <2h. :eyes:
Jordan - PM: Dependency note: KMS delay blocks Private deploy checklist. @ops-bot opened quota request for q3-gpu. Also routing v2 needs a formal loadtest plan before widening canary.
ops-bot: Created infra ticket infra#7654 for GPU quota request and linked compliance audit. ETA ~48h.
Alex M: Next step for routing v2: run staging smoke loadtest with sample workload (small bursts + sustained). I'll run it by EOD and share results. If pass, expand canary to 5% traffic.
Maria P: Dumping short log snippet for the memory spike:
```
2026-03-19T14:22:03Z service=embed-cache p95=820ms mem=6.1GB
```
Suspect batch sizing on long prompts; testing smaller batch windows now.
Sam L: For KMS, I've flagged compliance and infra. Proposed short-term fallback: keep customer-managed keys on old flow until integration finishes, log access path. Is that acceptable to compliance? @Jordan - PM
Jordan - PM: Short-term fallback OK if we add audit logging + export controls. Action items (please update tickets when done): - Alex M: staging loadtest (due 1932120000) - Maria P: root cause & mitigations for p95 mem spike (due 1932118000) - Sam L: compliance verdict + mitigation plan for KMS slip (due 1932125000) Thanks all :wave:
Alex M: noted, will update infra ticket with loadtest script & results. Also will ping @Devon post-test for CR follow-up.
Devon (eng-runtime): Will review PR #5480 after lunch; DM me if urgent.
Jordan - PM: TL;DR: routing v2 canary = good progress, embed-cache = shipped but mem p95 flare, KMS = slipped (audit/quota). Owners have next steps and due dates, will reconvene async.
